title: Trial of Torture
summary: Keep the tortured prisoners alive through four enemy waves, then defeat Punisher Veshtaq.
overview: Keep the tortured prisoners alive through four enemy waves, then defeat Punisher Veshtaq.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Four-enemy waves arrive two minutes apart. Pick up every incoming enemy before it reaches the prisoners.
Clearing an early wave summons a Wraith of Agony. Defeat it to produce the relief effect for the trial.
After all sixteen wave enemies are defeated, Punisher Veshtaq appears. Finish the boss while maintaining protection of the prisoners.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
